talking_points.headline: Agentic finance may progress from bounded tasks to more consequential decisions
talking_points.context_html: The UOB report’s respondents expect structured machine-to-machine payments and controlled enterprise workflows to precede consumer applications and autonomous credit decisioning. This is a forecast from a small respondent group, but highlights why change plans should distinguish execution of delegated tasks from autonomous financial decision-making.

AI & Technology.title: AI Agents Will Enter Finance Gradually: UOB Report
AI & Technology.summary: A UOB report, based on eight respondents across payments, infrastructure and digital assets, describes agentic finance as likely to develop gradually: structured machine-to-machine payments first, followed by enterprise workflows, with consumer uses and autonomous credit decisioning further out. Respondents identify liability, agent identity, interoperability and governance as adoption challenges. For banking change leaders, the report offers a view of potential sequencing and control issues, not evidence of adoption by banks or a settled industry roadmap.
